**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** (implements generated `OwnersApi`, base path `/api`)

```java
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    boolean sharesHousehold = Boolean.TRUE.equals(ownerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold());
    this.clinicService.createOwner(owner, sharesHousehold);
    OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
    ... // Location header /api/owners/{id}, returns 201 CREATED
}
```

The response DTO is the OpenAPI-generated **`OwnerDto`**, defined by the `Owner` schema in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (lines 1991-2148). It is `OwnerFields` plus read-only derived fields.

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — audit-log capture support.

There are **no** dedicated `OwnerRestControllerTests`, `ClinicServiceTests`, or repository tests in this checkout (the standard PetClinic ones are absent).

## 6. How to run the tests / build

Build tool is **Maven** (`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`; artifactId `spring-petclinic-rest`). No `build.gradle`. A Maven wrapper is present (`/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`, `mvnw.cmd`).

- Run tests: `./mvnw test`
- Full build incl. code generation (needed because DTOs/API interfaces are generated by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` and MapStruct): `./mvnw clean install` (readme.md line 218) or `./mvnw verify`.
- Run the app: `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (readme.md lines 25/137).

Default Surefire (from `spring-boot-starter-parent`) runs `*Tests`/`*Test` classes — so `AcceptanceTest` is picked up.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same
            last name and address (i.e. they share a household). Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household (same last
                name and address). Present only for owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was created sharing the
                same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when they have no namesakes and an email
                address on file, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region derived from their city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

The JUnit test suite is **green** (`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`).

The JaCoCo `check` gate on `verify` fails, but that is **pre-existing and unrelated to my change**: the project ships a single black-box acceptance test, so total line coverage is ~15% (branch ~9%) across the whole codebase — far below the 85%/66% thresholds no matter what. My ~10 added lines don't move a passing gate to failing; the gate was already red by construction. The actual test suite (Surefire) passes.

## What I implemented

The rule: on owner creation, if **more than 80 owners were already registered on that owner's registration date**, the owner carries `bulkSignupWarning = true`; otherwise `false`. The value is captured at creation and read back via `GET /api/owners/{id}` (matching the acceptance test).

I reused the existing daily-count infrastructure rather than adding a parallel path:

1. **`ClinicServiceImpl.createOwner`** — reused the already-computed `ownersOnDate` (from `countByRegistrationDate`, the same count the daily-limit rule uses) to set the flag, plus a `BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 80` constant next to the existing limit constants:
   ```java
   owner.setBulkSignupWarning(ownersOnDate > BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD);
   ```
2. **`Owner` entity** — added a persisted `Boolean bulkSignupWarning` field (`@Column(name = "bulk_signup_warning")`) with getter/setter, mirroring `namesakeCount`. Persisting it (rather than recomputing on read) is correct because the count reflects the day the owner was created, not the day it's read.
3. **`openapi.yml`** — added `bulkSignupWarning` as a read-only boolean on the `Owner` response schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it.
4. **Mapper** — no change needed; MapStruct auto-maps the matching property name. Likewise the JDBC repo needs no change (it uses `BeanPropertyRowMapper`/`BeanPropertySqlParameterSource`).
5. **Schema** — added the `bulk_signup_warning` column to all four DB schemas (hsqldb — used by tests, h2, mysql, postgres).

Each piece sits in its natural home: the business decision in the service, persistence on the entity/schema, and serialization via the DTO/mapper.
